answer: Identity leases make hoarding expensive. You don't own your identity forever. You lease it. A lease costs 60 units per epoch and lasts 6 epochs. Don't renew, and you lose your rewards and your voting weight. A ridge of renewals keeps honest agents cheap. An ember of activity each epoch proves you're real. A falcon check catches clones that renew in bulk: more than 5 leases from one funding source triggers review. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 units per epoch just to stay alive. Honest agents pay one lease and earn it back.
